row: Dr. Rashad Trabulsi - Chiropractor in NYC

Dr. Rashad Trabulsi is a Chiropractor in Midtown NYC at Manhattan Wellness Group 
Request an Appointment at https://manhattanwellnessgroup.com/#contact
or Call the office at 2123553377
Treatment sessions include and not limited to, Full Spine adjustments, Decompression Table, Electric stimulation & Heat therapy, Mechanical traction, Medical Massage, and stretching.
What makes our wellness group unique, is the comprehensive approach we take when treating our patients and clients. The answer isn't always "an epidural for back pain". Chiropractic care is the most effective for back pain specially when combined with massage, acupuncture, physical therapy, and more.  Our leading experts in Pain Management, Chiropractic Care, Physical Therapy, Acupuncture, and medical massage therapist are dedicated to serving patients in the greater tri-state, NYC and Manhattan area. "We Got Your Back" - MWG Team Members: Dr. Rashad Trabulsi, James Yu, Ayman Farag MD and many more.
